audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Kled and First item read Skill; the already-audited mirror (kayle__kled) locked both rows to Kayle. Also diffRating said 4/10 and report[14] called it a 'Favoured matchup' while diff already read HARD and the Emerald+ win rate is 45.45%.
audit.why: The mirror flipped rows 4-5 to Kayle in matched pairs; leaving Kled here would make the two pages disagree. And the page's own prose (whys[4], mid, late) says her R bails her out at 6 and she takes over after — a 4/10 'favoured' label contradicts both the prose and the sub-50% win rate.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side/win[4] and phases[5].side/win[5] set to Kayle as matched pairs with ratings 4/10 and 3/10; diffRating 7.5/10, tone re-coloured, difficulty and final-rating prose re-worded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6' with no cooldown, so 'bait it' had no timeframe.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 that is a 160-second window after she spends it — the single longest punish window in the lane, and worth stating as a number.
audit.corrected: The 160s figure written into the first Do and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing named Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset, and the anti-heal line said only 'his healing' without naming Celestial Blessing or its cooldown. dontsFull[1] ('Fight late vs her R') and dosFull[2] ('Deny her CS + XP') carried boilerplate bodies about wasting a cooldown that had nothing to do with their titles.
audit.why: Starfire Spellblade (E, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) is an auto reset, so her burst opens on an attack wind-up — that is the disengage cue, not the cast. Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s heal, which is what Grievous Wounds is actually bought against.
audit.corrected: Auto-reset tell added to the interactions row; Celestial Blessing and its 15s named in itemization; the two mismatched Do/Don't bodies rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by whether you kill her by level 3 — every wave she farms is yours lost.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — Q-pull + W her.
edits.after: Divine Judgment (160s) is her get-out. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 160s at rank 1 — bait it, then engage inside that whole window.

edits.before: Kayle wastes Divine Judgment (Invuln) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Every wave she farms buys her the ranged form; starve her to level 3.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her R turns invulnerable mid-combo — your burst hits nothing.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Eclipse, then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — Celestial Blessing (W) heals her every 15s through your chip.
